ceramic brackets with metal slot are more resistant to sliding than conventional stainless steel brackets.

the use of Teflon coated wires in combination with ceramic brackets with metal slot would reduce the frictional resistance and hence the force required for tooth movement.
Teflon coating of the archwire is the most efficient method to reduce frictional resistance in orthodontics.

the frictional resistance can be significantly reduced by using Teflon-coated archwire and stainless steel ligature.
